label_schema.format: joint_id cx cy w h lt_x lt_y v lb_x lb_y v rb_x rb_y v rt_x rt_y v
label_schema.keypoint_semantics: LED panel corners; latest user instruction supersedes light-bar endpoints
label_schema.coordinates: normalized to original image dimensions; no pre-resize to 640
label_schema.partial_occlusion_status: Implemented for controlled opaque-plate fixtures with area and sampled-exposure checks; not a general production sampler

keypoints.surface: LED emitting front panel, not outer frame or printed glyph
keypoints.runtime_order: Keep semantic order fixed under 3D transforms; horizontal flip permutation is [3,2,1,0]

keypoint_status: User selected LED panel corners; extracted from front face and projected for visual verification
sampling_region_status: Geometric mask from the object and material named in sampling_config.json, built by tools/placement/sample_field.py. Not a surveyed rulebook boundary, and accepted poses are rejection-sampled.
notes: Do not derive class IDs directly from material names such as LED-7blue
LED material replacement must update class_id and color_id atomically
Purple, none-color, unknown and all remaining classes are not yet fully validated
Height must use the actual field surface, not global Z=0
Validation previews use a temporary camera, not production camera calibration
